name: Zeus 0.41.0
body:
Zeus 0.41.0 is a big catch-up release: a first-run setup, split view and floating chat bubbles to try, much faster search, features from upstream ZapFast, and motion almost everywhere.

## New

- **First-run setup.** A new copy of Zeus walks you through the look, your name, notifications and privacy before it shows the QR code, with a live preview beside each step.
- **Zeus shows its window while it loads.** Instead of a splash, the outline of the chat list and chat appears at once and fades into the real thing.
- **Split view and a pop-out chat (Experimental).** Open a second chat beside the first, or pull a chat out into its own window. Turn it on in Settings, Experimental.
- **Chat bubbles (Experimental).** Keep chats as floating circles over your other apps and open one as a small chat card.
- **Sent, Delivered and Read labels.** The newest message you sent says where it is in words instead of ticks, and the time shows only after a five minute gap.
- **Block and unblock contacts** from a chat's menu or the contact panel, with a list of blocked contacts in Settings.
- **Disappearing messages.** Set a chat's timer from its menu; the chat says when the timer changes.
- **Link previews on what you send.** A link you type gets its preview card before you send it. The phone's "Disable link previews" setting is respected.
- **Animated Lottie stickers** play in chats.
- **Format from the right-click menu.** Right-click selected text in the message field for Bold, Italic, Strikethrough and Monospace.
- **Groups in common.** A person's info card lists the groups you share, and each one opens its chat.
- **Paste as plain text** with Ctrl+Shift+V (Cmd+Shift+V on a Mac).
- **New chat picks the first match on Enter.**
- **Download folders per chat**, and the tray icon shows the unread count.
- **One theme picker.** Accent colours now work with every theme, and the Glass slider frosts the WhatsApp theme too.
- **A message menu you can trim.** Choose which rows the right-click menu shows in Settings, Message menu, or switch it to icons only.
- **Motion everywhere.** Photos and videos grow out of their bubble and close back into it, a sent message rises out of the message field, messages ripple on springs as you scroll, chat list rows glide when a chat moves up, deleted messages close their gap, and the chat panel has a springy overscroll.
- **The contact panel's tiles** are Call, Video call, Mute and Search, and Media, Docs and Links slide in as pages.
- The benchmark is heavier, records whether the computer is on battery, and has a search phase.

## Fixed

- **Chats keep loading after days away.** A chat with many waiting messages used to make Zeus drop and reconnect over and over, loading a little each time. It now takes the backlog in one go, and reconnects within seconds when the connection is lost.
- **Search is much faster.** Typing waits for a short pause before searching, results come from an index instead of reading every message, and the result list scrolls smoothly. Matching is plain text only, no fuzzy matches.
- **History loads in short runs.** Zeus asks the phone for older messages a little at a time and rests in between, instead of flooding it.
- **Scrolling past messages with many reactions** no longer slows down.
- **The floating bubbles no longer show a thin rectangle around them** on Windows 11.
- Text sizes and spacing follow one scale across the app, and chat list dates are shorter.
- Editing a message keeps its bubble's size until the text outgrows it.
- The send button sits evenly in the message field's rounded end.
- A video call's camera opens on Macs whose cameras list unusual frame rates.
- The app says Zeus, not ZapFast, everywhere you read it.

## Thanks

Thanks to Pratyaksh Mehrotra ([@pratyakshm](https://github.com/pratyakshm)) for settling the motion tests, and to [@RathnamS089](https://github.com/RathnamS089) for the search index and the gentler history loading. Blocking, disappearing messages, link previews, Lottie stickers, text formatting from the menu and groups in common come from upstream ZapFast by Carmine Paolino.

Not tried by us: the Linux and macOS builds. Split view and chat bubbles are experimental and off by default.

name: Zeus 0.40.0
body:
Zeus 0.40.0 brings in Pratyaksh's fork: ZapFast 0.20.1's group calls and group tools, a big cut in memory, Metal on macOS, and smoother pickers and scrolling.

## New

- **Group calls.** Start a voice or video call from a group's header, answer group calls here, and join call links. If WhatsApp has not turned group calling on for linked devices on your account, Zeus says so.
- **Echo cancelling in calls.** Your speakers no longer echo back to the other side, and quiet voices are lifted.
- **Group tools in the info panel.** Admins can add people, share or reset the invite link, change group permissions, and promote, demote or remove members.
- **Metal on macOS.** The Mac app draws with Metal and holds about 90 MB less while its window is open. The chat header and message field are solid there instead of frosted.
- **New messages ease in.** A new message springs into place and the chat glides up to make room for it.
- **Updates show on the rail** instead of in a popup.
- **Open the last chat**, a new setting for starting where you left off. Zeus still opens on its welcome page by default.
- **The benchmark shows CPU per frame**, so a result tells a slow app apart from a slow screen. It now runs in Zeus's own Dark theme with the glass at its clearest.

## Fixed

- **Much less memory.** Zeus keeps only the open chat and the last two you left in memory, frees stickers, GIFs, voice messages and previews as soon as nothing shows them, and holds less while linking a phone, syncing history or sending large files.
- **No more freezes when opening the emoji or sticker picker.** Opening the emoji picker held the window for up to a second, and a shelf of stickers for up to two. Both now open at once and fill in as their pictures are ready.
- **Smoother scrolling past new emoji and stickers.** Each one used to cost the screen a moment the first time it appeared.
- Video calls use less CPU, and calls wait for microphone and camera permission before they start.
- A missed call's time lines up with its label, and you can call back from it.
- Selecting text in a long chat no longer slows Zeus down.
- Light WhatsApp-style bubbles and list rows no longer cast a shadow.

## Thanks

Thanks to Pratyaksh Mehrotra ([@pratyakshm](https://github.com/pratyakshm)) for the fork this release is built on: bringing in ZapFast 0.20.1, the memory work, Metal on macOS, the new message animations, the rail update badge and the Open the last chat setting. Thanks also to everyone behind ZapFast 0.20.1, whose group calls, echo cancelling and group tools came with it.

name: Zeus 0.36.0
body:
Zeus 0.36.0 is lighter and calmer: it uses much less memory, runs smoothly on high refresh rate screens, and Halloween has been packed away until next year.

## New

- **A built-in benchmark.** Settings > About can run a two-minute test of smoothness, memory, CPU and GPU with sample chats, and save or share the results. Your own chats are never used.
- **Animated stickers play on their own** in a chat while they are on screen, and loop.
- **Doodle density.** A new slider sets how many doodles fill the wallpaper, and the doodle sliders now read like the Glass slider, with names at both ends.
- **Zeus opens on its welcome page** instead of the last chat you had open.
- **Roomier message field.** It sits evenly inside the chat, with the chat's corners rounded to match it, and the text starts a little further from the emoji button.

## Fixed

- **Much less memory.** Pictures and stickers you have scrolled past are let go sooner, and a window left alone or minimized keeps only what it shows. In our test, peak memory dropped from about 490 MB to under 390 MB, and idle memory from about 430 MB to about 125 MB.
- **Chats open whole**, with their newest messages already in place, instead of blank for a moment.
- The react and reply buttons fade in and out gently and no longer shift messages while you hover.
- The Glass slider now changes only the frosted header, message field and menus, so the chat and chat list keep their colour across the whole slider.
- The chat list no longer casts a shadow across the chat beside it, and the dark band under message bubbles is gone.
- Short messages show their whole time underneath instead of cutting it off, and a photo no longer shows its time twice.
- The composer appears the moment an admin opens a group to everyone.
- Favourite chats no longer retry syncing in an endless loop.
- Specially crafted text and pictures can no longer slow down or crash Zeus.
- Scrolling on macOS is smoother.
- Spacing in the doodle settings is more even.

## Removed

- The Halloween look (orange theme, night wallpaper, pumpkin icons, spooky sounds and surprises). If you had it on, Zeus switches back to the classic doodles and sounds.

## Thanks

Thanks to Rathnam S for letting go of pictures and stickers in an idle window.

name: Zeus 0.35.0
body:
Zeus 0.35.0 is about calm and polish: the chat holds still while you scroll, everything opens and closes with the same smooth motion, and stickers and chat info got some love.

## New

- **Stickers fly into the chat.** A sticker you send from the picker glides into the conversation and stays visible on its way.
- **Chat info matches the chat card**, and you can drag photos, videos and files from it straight into another chat.
- **Smoother motion everywhere.** Popups, panels and menus now open and close with the same easing, toasts are calmer, and Settings has a slider for how strong the frosted glass is.
- **Frosted chat list header** that fades in as you scroll, with an accent coloured scroll bar in the chat list and the chat.
- **Unread counts** show the whole number instead of stopping at 99+.

## Fixed

- **The chat and the chat list no longer jump while you scroll.**
- The chat only follows new messages when you are already at the bottom, so reading older messages is not interrupted.
- Stickers that are a single frame animation now show up.
- Expired favourite stickers are set aside again instead of being asked for over and over.
- The full size picture in the viewer is let go once you move on or close it, which saves memory.
- Photos use less memory, and the media cache cleans itself up.
- The frosted glass no longer draws over a window that was closed and reopened.
- Certain broken video files can no longer freeze video or sticker playback.
- On macOS, the Dock icon is sharper when Zeus runs outside its app bundle.

## Thanks

Thanks to Rathnam S for the single frame sticker fix, the viewer memory fix, the favourite sticker fix, the frosted glass fix and the macOS Dock icon.

name: Zeus 0.30.0
body:
Zeus 0.30.0 is a big one: Halloween arrives, touchpad swipes come to every platform, and pictures sent together now travel as one album.

## New

- **Halloween.** An orange theme over any theme and accent, a night wallpaper, pumpkin and ghost icons, spooky doodles and sounds, and the odd ghost, skeleton or candy drifting by. Each part can be switched on its own in Settings, Halloween, or the whole look turned off.
- **Touchpad swipes.** Swipe a chat with two fingers to archive, pin, mute, favourite or mark it read, swipe a message to reply to it, and swipe the open chat away. Settings chooses what each swipe does, and a swiped change to a chat offers Undo in a toast.
- **Albums.** Pictures and clips chosen together are sent as one album, with one download button and save options in the right-click menu.
- **Edit messages in place:** double-click your own text to edit it in its bubble.
- **Reactions popup** lists who reacted with room for three people, and its chips add or remove your own reaction.
- **Mute submenu** in a chat's right-click menu, and a cooldown that quiets notifications during a flood of messages.
- **Frosted chat list header**, and the chat search now finds names with letters left out, below the exact matches.
- **Eased menus and popups** that open and close smoothly.
- **Drafts** keep the caret at the end when you come back, and a chat with a draft sorts as if you had just written in it.
- Updates are checked every two hours.

## Fixed

- Zeus no longer keeps redrawing the window while it sits idle with a menu closed, which saves battery.
- Tab moves from a text field to the next one, so you can type a new lock code and then its confirmation.
- A forwarded photo without a caption has an even rim on both sides.
- The maximized window's title bar on Windows is as tall as the floating one.
- Toasts now sit at the bottom left, stacked above the status banner, instead of covering the chat.
- The reply preview above the composer is back, with even padding on a reply quote.
- The time stays visible on narrow pictures, and the typing row lines up with messages.
- The search box's focus ring is quieter.

name: Zeus 0.25.0
body:
Zeus 0.25.0 brings the recent look-and-feel work together and adds a choice of update channel.

## New

- **Update channel.** In Settings, About, pick Stable (tested releases only) or Beta (early builds first). The choice is remembered, and the next check follows it.
- **Doodle wallpapers.** Pick a doodle style, then set its intensity and colour; the wallpaper also shows through the composer.
- **Frosted composer and go-to-bottom button**, with reaction chips on the far side of the bubble and a remembered picker mode.
- **Typing dots** now appear inside an incoming bubble, and the gap above the composer is tighter.
- **Media previews** in the composer follow the shape of the photo or video you are sending.

## Fixed

- The update window no longer keeps an offer from a channel you have switched away from.

name: Zeus 0.20.1
body:
Zeus 0.20.1 is the first release with downloads for Linux and Mac, next to the Windows installer. The app itself is the same as 0.20.0.

## New

- **Zeus for Linux.** Packages for Debian and Ubuntu (`.deb`), Fedora and openSUSE (`.rpm`), an `.AppImage` that runs on most distributions, and a plain `.tar.gz`, for both x86_64 and aarch64.
- **Zeus for Mac.** A universal `.dmg` for Apple silicon and Intel Macs. It is not signed by Apple, so the first time, right-click Zeus in Applications and choose Open.

The Linux and Mac builds are brand new and have not had much testing yet. If something does not work, please tell me what system you are on.

name: Zeus 0.20.0
body:
Zeus 0.20.0 gives the whole app a softer, rounder look, a new Settings page, and a quicker way to forward.

## New

- **A rounder, frosted look everywhere.** Menus, dialogs, cards and buttons have larger rounded corners, and menus and dialogs sit on frosted glass. The highlight around a selected message follows its corners.
- **Settings in the side list.** Settings categories now open in the left column, with the page itself on frosted glass and more room between rows.
- **Drag to forward.** Drag a message onto a chat in the list to forward it there, and drag photos and files out to Explorer or the desktop. The Forward dialog has a tidier layout.
- **Check for updates.** Settings has a Check for updates button, and Zeus asks you when an update is found.
- **Edit with the Up arrow.** Press Up in an empty message box to edit the last message you sent.
- **Reply and Edit first.** The right-click menu on a message now starts with Reply, then Edit.
